seed: THE CLAIM: where a layer sits and how big it is is no longer a section in the right hand panel at all, and the numbers are still there the moment you ask for them. On the morning of 2026-09-15 those four boxes were a section sitting open at the top of the panel for every layer, forever, and they never fitted: a piece of text picked in a three layer document asked the panel for 1052 points, a laptop window gives it 688 and the largest window this display allows gives it 968. The first answer was to move them up the order so they were at least on screen. The better answer, which is what this walk now checks, is that moving something is what the pointer is for and an exact number is wanted rarely: the section is gone, the panel is 130 points shorter, and the same fields open on Layer, Position and Size (Option Command P) or a right click on the layer's row, over the thing they are about. This walk builds the same document at three window sizes, picks the text, and fails if the section has come back, then asks for the numbers and types one.

steps.comment: A laptop window, which is the size every claim about this panel is argued at.
THE TEST. Not scrolled off the bottom: not there at all.
...and the sections that used to sit under it are all whole, which is what the 130 points bought.

steps.note: text picked in a laptop window. Read dockSections: there is no Position & Size in it, and Appearance now starts where it used to end.

steps.comment: A small window, where there is least room of all.

steps.note: the same in a 608 point panel, which is the tightest this is ever asked for.

steps.comment: And the largest window this display allows, where the whole panel fits for the first time.

Effects by its HEADER rather than whole. The dock asks 1052 points for this document and the largest window this display gives hands it 941, so the last 30 of Effects sit under the fold: the room the four boxes gave back has been taken again by the sections that arrived after them, Motion among them. What this walk is about still holds — all four are reachable without hunting, which they were not while Position & Size sat at the top — and the 30 points are filed as their own question.

steps.note: text picked in the largest window this display gives. Layers, Text and Appearance are whole and Effects' header is in view, which the panel could not manage at any size while the four boxes were in it.

steps.comment: THE OTHER HALF: the numbers are still there, and this is how you get them. The action is the command the Layer menu and the layer's right click both run.

steps.note: the numbers, opened over the piece of text rather than at the top of a column.

steps.comment: The number landed, which is the whole reason these fields exist.

steps.note: one undo takes the typed width back in one step, exactly as it did when the fields lived in the panel.

steps.comment: And with nothing picked there is nothing to place, so the command does nothing rather than opening an empty popover.

steps.note: clicked the empty canvas, which deselects: the action's own line in this log must say the menu row is dimmed and nothing opened.
